{{Top|leg}}
'''Spitar P'ton''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] when the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] broke down in the [[Ku'Bakai system/Legends|system]]. While his crew fixed the [[Ion flux stabilizer/Legends|ion flux stabilizer]], P'ton explored the planet and went to a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] restaurant. A man of exotic tastes, the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] food appealed to him, and he "hired" Kubaz [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Kalro Mear]] and a dozen assistants.
